scripts.build-studio: node -e "const cp=require('child_process'); const run=(cmd)=>cp.execSync(cmd,{stdio:'inherit'}); if(process.env.NETLIFY){console.log('Netlify detected: installing and building studio'); run('cd studio && npm ci && npm run build');} else {run('cd studio && npm run build');}"
scripts.build-web: node -e "const cp=require('child_process'); const run=(cmd)=>cp.execSync(cmd,{stdio:'inherit'}); if(process.env.NETLIFY){console.log('Netlify detected: building web only'); run('cd web && npm ci && npm run build');} else {run('lerna bootstrap && (cd studio && SANITY_AUTH_TOKEN=$SANITY_DEPLOY_STUDIO_TOKEN npm run graphql-deploy) && (cd web && npm run build)');}"
scripts.postinstall: node -e "if (process.env.NETLIFY) { console.log('Skipping lerna bootstrap on Netlify frontend build'); process.exit(0) } require('child_process').execSync('lerna bootstrap', { stdio: 'inherit' })"
